Feature export reads the selected files and schema.prisma model sources as regular files inside the app directory only. Symlink aliases into protected app paths are refused, including a path swapped for a symlink while the export runs.
Remote installs are dry-run by default; `--apply` is the explicit mutation path.
No data, uploads, secrets, env values, env.yaml, .git, .benmore, logs, or generated bm.d.ts are copied.
Install runs the write-time hardcoded-secret scan on every text file and every schema model source; a match blocks the plan (`<path>: hardcoded secret` / `model <Name>: hardcoded secret`).
Schema install is additive only: model collisions block instead of renaming silently.

A pack's models are appended to the target's schema.prisma, so they install only into an app whose schema is schema.prisma, or one that declares no table yet. For an app whose schema is schema.sql or schema.yaml, a pack with models, or one that carries a schema.prisma file, is blocked in the dry run and in the apply with a `schema.prisma: this app's schema is schema.sql ...` collision, with or without `--replace`, and nothing is written: the app would load schema.prisma instead and its own tables would stop being part of its schema. A pack exported without `--models` installs there; add its tables to the app's own schema file, or move the app to schema.prisma first (api({at:'schema'}) schema_file).

An install does not make the app drop data unasked. The plan asks the target instance what it would drop when it reloads with the pack's files: a table that holds rows whose model the pack's schema.prisma leaves out (`--replace`, whole-app clone-over), and a table or column holding data that a migrations/*.sql file the pack adds or changes drops. Each loss is listed in the plan's `table_drops` (`schema.prisma: tags (2 rows)`), and the plan is blocked, in the dry run and in the apply, until `allow_table_drop` is passed (from the CLI: `benmore feature install ... --allow-table-drop` or `benmore clone ... --allow-table-drop`); the dry run with it still lists the loss. A table without rows is not listed and is dropped without it, as for a schema.prisma write (api({at:'schema'}) removed_models). One install checks at most 12 new or changed migration files; a pack with more lists `migrations/: <n> migration files not checked for data loss` instead and is blocked until `allow_table_drop` is passed, or until the files are pushed first (`benmore push migrations/<file>` checks each). The app takes a backup before it applies the change.
A pack that carries schema.yaml is blocked for an app whose schema.sql is written by hand (`schema.yaml: this app's schema.sql is written by hand ...`): api({at:'schema'}) schema_file.
Whole-source exports set `whole_source: true` in `feature.yaml`; selected path/model/flow exports and curated packs do not.

File collisions block unless `--replace` is supplied; `--delete-missing` also requires `--replace`, `whole_source: true`, and root `app.yaml` + `schema.prisma`, so it is only for whole-app clone-over.
`--route-prefix` moves static route files under `static/<prefix>/...`, renames `flows/*.yaml` files, rewrites known custom API route strings, and reports file/route renames in dry-run output.
`--model-prefix` renames pack Prisma models and rewrites inferred table-name tokens in text files/flows before planning/apply; dry-runs report model renames.

`--route-map FROM=TO` and `--model-map Old=New` provide exact rewrites when a global prefix is not expressive enough; maps rewrite static route files, single-route flow files, route strings, Prisma models, and inferred table-name tokens.

Pack payloads are bounded before install: decoded archive max 64 MiB, uncompressed source max 128 MiB, per-entry max 64 MiB, feature.yaml max 1 MiB, and max 2000 archive entries. The whole decompressed stream, including skipped entries and tar headers, is capped at the source limit plus 16 KiB of framing per entry; a larger archive fails. The archive is only parsed after the caller's editor access to the target app is confirmed.
`--delete-missing` cannot be combined with selected paths/models/flows, prefixes, or exact maps; transformed installs are additive/update operations, not whole-app replacement.
The platform snapshots destination git before apply, deletes newly-added pack files on failed apply, and rolls back tracked files.
